source_note: The first 6 turns of a 21-turn VideoMemBench dialogue. Questions, gold answers and dependency labels are copied from the dataset. The video combines the corresponding evidence excerpts; displayed timestamps retain the original source timeline.

Question numbers preserve the original dialogue order; overlapping evidence windows can activate more than one question.

source_video.source_url_basis: YouTube video ID preserved in the original keynote source filename and verified against the dataset source-video mapping.

turns.question: What feature is the coding agent asked to add to the app?
What four actions does the agent plan in order to implement the feature identified in T1?
turns.answer: Create PersonView, preview a screenshot in light and dark appearances, explore the Person struct, and test on device.
turns.answer_text: Create PersonView, preview a screenshot in light and dark appearances, explore the Person struct, and test on device.

turns.question: Which three external coding models are shown as selectable in Xcode, and which company provides each one?
turns.answer: Claude by Anthropic, Codex by OpenAI, and Gemini by Google.
turns.answer_text: Claude by Anthropic, Codex by OpenAI, and Gemini by Google.

turns.question: Which two access-level labels are listed for non-persistent folder access?

options.A: View only, or view and edit
options.B: Open only, or open and modify
options.C: Browse only, or browse and update
options.D: Read only, or read, write, and delete
options.F: Read only, or read and execute
options.H: Read only, or read and write

turns.answer_text: Read only, or read and write

turns.question: What are the three stages of the app-localization workflow, in order?
Which three sources of context are supplied during the second stage of the workflow identified in T5?
turns.answer: Relevant code, the surrounding UI, and translation guidance.
